description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our Working Student – Robot Pilot / Data Collection (m/f/d), you are the hands-on operational backbone of our physical AI data pipeline. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it. You will directly operate state-of-the-art robotic systems to collect high-quality training data, playing a foundational role in how our robots learn new tasks through imitation and perception. Your Responsibilities Operate industrial robotics equipment using VR-based teleoperation systems and alternative control interfaces on-site. Demonstrate complex manipulation tasks to generate clean, high-precision datasets for AI and imitation learning models. Record and track repeated training episodes systematically, adhering strictly to experimental procedures and guidelines. Review collected data episodes to perform immediate quality assurance and flag obvious operational or recording errors. Document technical bugs, edge cases, and system anomalies clearly to support hardware and software engineering teams. Provide continuous user feedback to improve the design, ergonomics, and usability of our robot control interfaces. Ensure safe, careful, and responsible handling of advanced robotic systems and experimental hardware at all times. We're looking for someone who has: Currently enrolled in or completed vocational training/a degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience with technical devices, gaming, VR headsets, remote-control systems, or activities requiring strong hand-eye coordination. High concentration, patience, and attention to detail during repetitive, quality-critical tasks. Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership mindset, high reliability, punctuality, and a pragmatic working style. Very good English skills (German is a plus). Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events- from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. description: Role Description Dropbox is building the knowledge layer that connects content, context, and action. As AI moves from assistants to systems that act, the structure and stewardship of enterprise knowledge becomes the difference between AI that helps and AI that fails. This role owns the context layer our AI depends on: what it can know, what it can trust, and what it is allowed to act on. You will lead the central function, setting the strategy, architecture, standards, and operating model that make enterprise knowledge reliable, current, and permissions-aware for both human and AI use, while domain experts stay accountable for the accuracy of their content. AI capability changes quickly, and this role changes with it. What a model can interpret, how content needs to be structured for retrieval, and what a system can safely act on all shift as the technology moves. You will track those shifts, translate them into practical standards, and revise your own past decisions when the ground moves under them. This is the first role of its kind at Dropbox. You will partner with IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Security, and your decisions will show up directly in how AI performs across the company. Responsibilities Define the source-of-truth strategy for enterprise knowledge: which systems are authoritative, what is indexed centrally versus fetched live, what is eligible for AI use, and what is archived or excluded, informed by an assessment of the authoritative sources behind our highest-value workflows. Define the enterprise standards that make content AI-ready across structure, metadata, provenance, and access, including where semantic models or knowledge graphs are warranted and where they are not, and translate them into authoring patterns adopted across domains. Design the control model for AI actions, including eligibility rules, preconditions, approval boundaries, escalation paths, and rollback requirements, so systems that act on enterprise knowledge stay traceable and safe as AI capabilities evolve. Lead platform and connector strategy across the content stack. Drive decisions on what is refactored, migrated, indexed in place, or consolidated, and partner with IT and Engineering on connector architecture and how AI systems are granted access to tools and sources. Build the federated operating model for enterprise content: stewardship across functions, domains accountable for their own accuracy within shared standards, and lifecycle policies covering review cadence, expiration, material-change triggers, and retirement, tied to business criticality. Define content quality in an AI context. Stand up retrieval and grounding evaluations for priority use cases, extend measurement to workflow traces and policy conformance as systems begin to act, and route findings back into the content lifecycle. Co-own the criteria for AI content eligibility, sensitivity classification, and permissions modeling with Legal, Privacy, and Security, including access boundaries for the tools AI systems can reach. Requirements 7+ years designing how information is structured, owned, and maintained at enterprise scale, including at least 2 years applying that work to AI retrieval and grounding. Direct experience preparing content for AI consumption, with working fluency in retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, semantic chunking, embeddings, vector search, and citations. Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic models that structure content for machine consumption. Track record building federated operating models across functions outside direct reporting lines, with evidence of metadata standards or authoring frameworks adopted at scale. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, Security, and business functions. Sound judgment on balancing central standards with domain expertise. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Atlassian, Microsoft 365 or Copilot Search, Slack, or Notion. Familiarity with structured authoring(such as DITA), controlled vocabularies, or knowledge operations methodologies such as KCS. Experience with AI evaluation tooling and frameworks for measuring retrieval quality, groundedness, and answer relevance. Background working in regulated, policy-heavy, or high-risk content domains. Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI guidance, or comparable risk frameworks. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve: Awareness:Understand yourself and others. Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. As AI moves from assistants to systems that act, the structure and stewardship of enterprise knowledge becomes the difference between AI that helps and AI that fails. AI capability changes quickly, and this role changes with it. What a model can interpret, how content needs to be structured for retrieval, and what a system can safely act on all shift as the technology moves. You will track those shifts, translate them into practical standards, and revise your own past decisions when the ground moves under them. This is the first role of its kind at Dropbox. You will partner with IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Security, and your decisions will show up directly in how AI performs across the company. description: At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: Location: Remote (Phillipines) Role overview: Instructure is looking for a versatile, solution-oriented graphic designer to join our creative team. You’ll be responsible for turning complex educational content into clean, impactful visual stories. From designing cornerstone assets for campaigns to building branded kits for marketing teams to use to exploring design-based solutions for new asset types, your work will fuel some of the marketing department’s most important projects and reach over 30 million educators and learners worldwide. What you’ll do: Brand stewardship: Maintain and evolve the visual identity of the Instructure learning ecosystem, including the visual relationship between our company and ecosystem and its respective products, programs, and services. You’ll ensure our brand remains consistent across digital, print, and environmental touchpoints. Multi-channel campaign design: Execute visual assets for global marketing campaigns, including social media, web banners, email templates, and long-form content. Event creative: Support large-scale events like InstructureCon by designing employee and attendee enablement pieces, including Zoom backgrounds, presentation graphics, one-pagers, and social media kits. Collaboration: Work with copywriters, content creators, and channel managers to ensure a cohesive user journey. Asset management: Manage a high-volume ticket queue (via Asana) and help maintain an organized, accessible library of brand assets for internal stakeholders. What you’ll need (requirements): Experience: 3–5+ years of professional graphic design experience (SaaS experience is a major plus). Technical mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign). Basic animation skills and proficiency in Canva and Figma are highly preferred. AI curiosity: A willingness to explore and experiment with a range of AI tools. Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating a clean aesthetic and the ability to simplify complex information into a digestible flow. Accessibility first: A deep understanding of WCAG accessibility standards as they apply to color contrast and digital design. Contextual thinking: The ability to apply learnings (about design tools, brand guidelines, Instructure audiences, and Instructure products) where applicable across your work. Communication: Strong interpersonal skills—you can explain the why behind your design choices and incorporate feedback gracefully. Bonus points if you have: Experience with motion graphics or video editing (After Effects/Premiere). Knowledge of prepress and print production for large-scale physical events. Prior experience working in an agile environment using Asana and Slack. Instructure values: Openness: We stay curious and collaborative. Relationships: We put people first. Equality: We build inclusivity into everything we design. Ownership: We take pride in the quality of our work. Simplicity: We believe simpler is smarter. Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes. Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate. All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws. Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About the Role: The Customer Onboarding Specialist is responsible for delivering high-quality technical onboarding experiences that reduce time-to-value and help customers successfully adopt Planet data, tools, and workflows. Sitting within the Education & Enablement team, this role works closely with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Product, and Revenue Operations to deliver a consistent, scalable onboarding experience across customer segments. The Onboarding Specialist leads the coordination of technical onboarding activities, contributes to live onboarding delivery, and supports the continuous improvement of onboarding content, campaigns, and processes. In partnership with Customer Success, this role also provides ongoing technical enablement for strategic customers across Latin America, helping customers continue building technical proficiency, adopt new capabilities, and maximize value from Planet products throughout their customer journey. This role serves as a trusted technical partner for customers, supporting long-term adoption through technical guidance, education, and enablement. This is a full-time, remote position based in Latin America. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week. Impact You’ll Own: Deliver tailored technical onboarding experiences that help customers successfully adopt Planet's products, data, and workflows while reducing time-to-value. Lead onboarding kickoff calls, coordinate onboarding activities, and deliver live onboarding sessions, technical training, and workshops for customers across Latin America. Partner closely with Customer Success Managers to provide ongoing technical enablement that helps strategic customers expand their use of Planet products, workflows, and capabilities beyond initial onboarding. Build trusted technical relationships with customers by providing continued education, guidance, and best practices that support long-term adoption and customer success. Design, maintain, and continuously improve onboarding resources, customer education content, and learning materials across Planet's education platforms. Coordinate onboarding activities across Education, Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Product, and Revenue Operations to ensure a seamless customer experience. Monitor onboarding engagement and customer feedback, contributing insights that improve onboarding experiences, customer adoption, and future education initiatives. What You Bring: 4+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer education, technical training, technical support, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role. Bachelor's degree in a related field. Professional fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, with the ability to confidently deliver customer onboarding and technical training in all three languages. Technical aptitude with the ability to understand complex customer workflows, explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and deliver engaging customer training and enablement. Experience working with GIS, remote sensing, or geospatial data platforms. Hands-on experience with coding or scripting (preferably Python) sufficient to understand customer workflows, troubleshoot issues, and support technical onboarding. Familiarity with adult learning principles and best practices for customer education and technical enablement. Ability to coordinate cross-functional customer onboarding activities while balancing organization, collaboration, stakeholder alignment, and customer needs. What Makes You Stand Out: Experience working in a SaaS, data, or developer-focused product environment. Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS), customer education platforms, or documentation systems. Experience supporting both live and scaled (self-service or automated) customer onboarding and enablement programs. Exposure to onboarding automation, customer engagement platforms, or lifecycle communications. Experience working with multilingual or cross-cultural customer audiences. Application Deadline: November 10, 2026 at 11:59p PT Benefits While Working at Planet: These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy. Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off Supplemental Medical and Dental Coverage Employee Wellness Program Home Office Reimbursement Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning Volunteering Paid Time Off #LI-REMOTE San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Why we care so much about Belonging. We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply! At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts. We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride. What this job can offer you You will own and improve the platforms Customer Experience runs on: Zendesk, Vitally, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the stack. This is hands-on platform work with real scope. You configure, automate, integrate, and maintain systems used every day by support and customer success teams. You work with autonomy on agreed priorities, use automation (including AI-assisted workflows where they fit), and partner with operations and technical teams when a problem needs more than configuration alone. You will see work through from scoping to production and ongoing ownership: testing changes, communicating with affected teams, documenting what you ship, and keeping platforms reliable as requirements grow. This role keeps that foundation solid as the business and product surface area grow. You will help CX scale without adding friction: fewer manual workarounds, clearer workflows, and platform changes that ship with proper testing, communication, and documentation. Strong platform operations also creates the conditions for automation and AI initiatives to land safely. The work sits close to the teams who use these tools every day, so the impact is direct and measurable. What you bring Strong ownership and autonomy: you spot what needs doing, set direction, and deliver without heavy oversight. Hands-on Zendesk experience in a production support environment: triggers, automations, views, groups, routing, macros, and comfort debugging via the API when needed. Platform operations experience in CX or customer success: you understand how support and CSM teams work, not just how admin screens are laid out. End-to-end delivery: scoping, stakeholder alignment, safe rollout, and steady-state ownership after go-live. Documentation as part of how you work. Accurate, accessible docs are part of done, not an afterthought. Sound judgment on when configuration or automation is the right fix, and when the problem needs a different approach. Automation experience in CX: low/no-code tools (Zapier, platform-native automations, or similar) and workflows that hold up in production. Practical familiarity with AI in support and success operations: agent assist, workflow automation, triage or routing helpers, or knowledge-backed tools. You do not need to be an ML engineer, but you should be comfortable working with AI-enabled workflows and knowing where they help versus add noise. Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns; able to partner with engineering on harder problems. Depth in Zendesk or a comparable support platform. Vitally or similar Customer Success platform experience is a strong plus. Willingness to work across more than one system in the stack. Clear written and spoken English. Remote-first experience is a plus. Key Responsibilities Platform administration and reliability Administer Zendesk, Vitally, and related CX tools: configuration, access, and day-to-day operational health. Own intake, triage, and delivery for platform requests from internal teams. Maintain documentation for configurations, automations, and integrations. Workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tooling Design and maintain triggers, automations, and data flows that reduce manual handling and keep work moving reliably through CX systems. Build and run integrations across the CX stack using APIs, webhooks, and low-code tools where that is the right tradeoff. Identify automation opportunities from ticket data, workflow friction, and team feedback; ship practical improvements, not automation for its own sake. Support AI-enabled workflows in CX (for example agent assist, routing or triage helpers, and intake automation): configure, test, document, and iterate with appropriate oversight and change control. Follow change management practices: test before production, communicate impact, document intent and ownership. Continuous improvement Use operational data and platform metrics to prioritize work and measure results. Identify fragile configs, process gaps, and technical debt; address them in a structured way. Support rollout of new channels, integrations, and workflow changes as CX requirements evolve. Cross-functional partnership Work with support, success, and operations teams to understand workflow needs and validate solutions before they ship. Partner with enablement on training and adoption when tooling changes affect frontline teams. Collaborate with product, engineering, and data teams on integrations and escalations that go beyond platform configuration.
